title: 第十五章 去而复返神秘女子第十六章 打死赵玲珑管你什么人
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 该死！
这档案也太草率了。
他原以为上面会有一些证据。
但现在看来，就这么一句话。
再往后方，便都是一些官员的自述，更无任何线索。
林玄心中发寒。
不同寻常！！！
这绝对不同寻常！
越是如此，越是让他感觉到，有人在刻意遮掩这一切！
这是想把真正的幕后元凶给摘除出去。
他继续向着其他档案那边继续搜索而去，以期能找到更多档案。
但就在这时。
走廊之中传来急促的脚步声，似乎有人在向着这边快速走来。
林玄眸光一冷，熄灭蜡烛，身躯骤然消失。
此时此刻，巡逻老张一脸惊疑，提着手电筒，正在沿着走廊快速走来。
他也是在楼下的时候，透过玻璃看到了档案室传来了微弱火光，这才赶过来查看一下。
这么晚了，居然还有人来档案室？
但是为何不开灯？
就在他刚要接近，突然眼前狂风一闪。
一只结实有力的大手从身后一把捂住他的嘴巴，让他整个身躯都动弹不得。
“司长今晚在吗？”
沙哑冰冷的声音从老张身后发出，如同九幽地狱传来的魔鬼声音，使得老张身躯颤栗，恐惧无比，胯下迅速湿成一片。
他发出呜呜的微弱声音。
直到林玄缓缓透开一丝指缝，才让他有惊恐声音传出。
“在三楼，最右边的房间...”
林玄重复一句。
老张很快觉察到后颈一疼，眼白翻起，当场昏厥过去。
林玄将他的身躯丢入档案室，身躯一闪，向着三楼方向快速掠去。
宽敞明亮的房间内。
西城区司长杨泰，身躯来回走动，眉头紧锁，疑似遇到了什么莫大难题一样，不时地发出叹息，看向桌岸上的几张报纸。
多事之秋！
现在真是前所未有的混乱时代！
他这位司长之位天知道还能做多久？
他拿起桌上报纸。
只见每张报纸上的头条都有一行醒目文字。
【西郊华金大厦，再次有人失踪，至今已是十八人在此消失。】
【海河浮尸案再添新魂，本月第十三具，死因成谜。】
【各大武馆再次要求废除传统武学...】
【京师之地，秘武逼宫，国府将要妥协，似乎要彻底废除传武...】
杨泰将报纸摔在桌上，揉着太阳穴。
这么多的事堆积到了一起。
无论哪一个，对他而言都不是好事。
content_en:
Damn it!
This file is too sloppy.
He had thought there would be some evidence on it.
But now it seems that it is just one sentence.
Further back, there are self-reports from some officials, and there are no clues.
Lin Xuan felt cold in his heart.
Unusual! ! !
This is definitely unusual!
The more this happened, the more he felt that someone was deliberately covering up all this!
This is to remove the real culprit behind the scenes.
He continued to search for other files, hoping to find more files.
But that's it.
There were rapid footsteps in the corridor, as if someone was walking quickly towards this side.
Lin Xuan's eyes turned cold, he extinguished the candle, and his body suddenly disappeared.
At this moment, Patrolman Zhang was walking quickly along the corridor with a surprised look on his face, holding a flashlight.
When he was downstairs, he saw a faint fire coming from the archives room through the glass, and then rushed over to check.
It's so late, and someone is still coming to the archives?
But why not turn on the lights?
Just as he was about to get closer, suddenly a strong wind flashed before his eyes.
A strong, strong hand covered his mouth from behind, making his entire body unable to move.
"Is the director here tonight?"
The hoarse and cold voice came from behind Lao Zhang, like the devil's voice coming from the Nine Nether Hell, which made Lao Zhang's body tremble with fear, and his crotch quickly became wet.
He made a weak whining sound.
It wasn't until Lin Xuan slowly opened a trace of his fingers that he heard a voice of panic.
"On the third floor, the room on the far right..."
"Third floor..."
Lin Xuan repeated.
Lao Zhang soon felt a pain in the back of his neck, the whites of his eyes rolled up, and he fainted on the spot.
Lin Xuan threw his body into the archives room, and in a flash, he quickly flew towards the third floor.
...
Inside the spacious and bright room.
Yang Tai, the director of Xicheng District, walked back and forth, frowning, as if he had encountered some huge problem. He sighed from time to time and looked at the newspapers on the table.
Troubled times!
These are truly unprecedented chaotic times!
God knows how long he can hold the position of director?
He picked up the newspaper from the table.
I saw a line of eye-catching text on the headlines of every newspaper.
[Someone is missing again at the Joaquin Building in the western suburbs. Eighteen people have disappeared here so far. 】
[The Haihe Floating Corpse Case has added a new soul, the thirteenth one this month, and the cause of death remains a mystery. 】
[Major martial arts schools once again demand the abolition of traditional martial arts...]
[In the land of the capital, secret martial arts force the palace. The government is about to compromise, and it seems that it will completely abolish the martial arts...]
Yang Tai threw the newspaper on the table and rubbed his temples.
So many things piled up together.
Either way, it's not a good thing for him.
